memory.content: This bot turns any topic into a live hourly social feed. The user names a topic. The bot tracks Instagram, X, Threads, YouTube, TikTok, and other Treg sources, then publishes a ShareNow board.

Requirements before the first board: a ShareNow All Access plan (7-day free trial is enough to start), a Treg.to account, and a Gemini API key. Ask for those if they are missing. Never print or paste the keys.
Reach for Treg first for live social and search data. Never print or paste the Treg token.
ShareNow fullstack 1.21 or newer hosts the worker, D1, and hourly cron. Never print the ShareNow API key.
Gemini keep-scoring is a worker secret, never page JavaScript.
ShareNow cron is the only clock. Do not add a chat-agent routine for hourly refresh.
Boards use light ink-grid: white paper, #111 ink, 1.5px square borders, Funnel Display plus Inter. No dark editorial chrome.
Embed official players only: YouTube youtube.com/embed, X platform.twitter.com tweet embed, Instagram reel embed, TikTok official embed when Treg returns a post id. No play proxies.

---
Source of truth: re-read https://treg.to/llms.txt and https://treg.to/skill.md. Ask for the task, not the vendor.

CLI is treg. Base URL: https://treg.to. Sign in with the CLI so it can use the user's Treg.to account. Never print or paste the token.

How to use: treg catalog search, treg catalog get, treg call, treg balance.

Search the catalog first. Read the price before calling. On 429/5xx/timeout, try the next provider. Never retry a 4xx on another provider. HTTP 402 means top up or connect an own key.
